question: AQWE is related to FVBJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, UKQY is related to ZPVD. To which of the following is JZFN related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, AQWE is related to FVBJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/490f83a7528fb2edf288198dcfe392df5c2ba451c4a37f3bb6215149bc28cb4f.png] 

For, UKQY is related to ZPVD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/069102f9f478ab286fd2cbce69ddcb4f6ddc0d7ea55d8ac3039717bbd08f8280.png] 

Similarly, for **JZFN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ffedd8d99b1d778394b05760d54d2a39e2313cf326651b56d082b3373971b05.png] 

So, JZFN will be related to **OEKS**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
